contents.name: Section 5, Iterative sparsification and Erdos-Hajnal for graphs of bounded VC-dimension
Theorem 5.1
contents.reason: This is the global bounded-VC-dimension Erdős–Hajnal theorem; its bigraph and VC-dimension route is not a consequence or prerequisite of the finite-family structural criterion proved on this page.

contents.name: Theorem 5.2
contents.reason: This theorem concerns graphs with no bi-induced copy of a bigraph. The current page uses ordinary induced forbidden families and does not introduce the separate bigraph framework needed to state or prove it.

contents.name: Lemma 5.5
contents.reason: The sparse-bigraph dichotomy is an auxiliary step in the bounded-VC proof. Its hypotheses use bi-induced copies and ultraregularity, neither of which belongs to the selected finite-family comb-decomposition route.

contents.name: Claim 5.6
contents.reason: The claim bounds how often an outside vertex is mixed on an ultraregular blockade. It serves the omitted bigraph proof of Lemma 5.5 rather than the source's Section 5 structural criterion.

contents.name: Lemma 5.7 (stated beginning)
contents.reason: This is the next iterative bigraph blockade lemma and was read only through its stated setup. Its polynomial sparse-bigraph alternatives are outside the present page's direct proof of property (*).
